Pin merged contract 2.4.0. Optional/missing channel file or channels:[] ONLY with token, otherwise preserve required nonempty file mode. Add mutually exclusive token/file, polling (15000/5000 default, min 1000), secret-dir settings; empty token-file env unset. File webhook exactly one literal url/urlEnv/urlFile, database definition refs only. remote-channels per-channel validation enforces 16384-byte definition cap, notify-local env prefix and basename/realpath confinement; invalid channel rejected independently. Migrate ledger 4->5 preserving supported legacy migrations, all entries/recipient progress; persist reference-only remote definitions and handled command rows. Atomic first-command admission + failed->pending + command insert, repeat-id dedup, terminal entry+all admitted-command updates in SAME transaction, postedState tracking and >7-day posted-finished prune with ledger tests. T2 consumes storage for reconciliation, T3 consumes command API for live resend. Wire DB-only startup and offline CLI format 5/lock exit 2; docs/AGENTS unsupported downgrade.

Deleted/invalid/unreadable configured file keeps last good, removing channel within valid file unshadows. Service-only Bearer/redirect manual. Reports after attempts and 60000-ms heartbeat: sanitized file views/failed/rejected/totals/shadowedIds; trim failed then fileChannels then rejected <=524288. Every exposed field has V1->DB V2, whole-id file V3, valid file removal->DB V2 on SAME running notifier/ledger; one shared API/receiver/SMTP set, fake timers. T3 adds command polling.

tasks.title: Live resend survives lost acknowledgements and sends one additional delivery
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, live resend/claim/result Files/Behavior, remaining Checks and Completion evidence; Decision 14 complete notify-side protocol; R1/R2 claim/results; Counterexamples (Resend); Security impact; Performance impact procedure 3 (notify); Acceptance evidence 2-4 and 7. Use T1 atomic durable ledger operations and T2 installed workers. Every 5000 ms claim commands and enqueue admitted keys ONLY after commit; known command id posts stored state without rerunning resend. Terminal settlement and admitted-command states remain atomic with entry update. Post oldest 20 unacknowledged states/poll; set postedState on 204/404/409 (once-only sanitized refusal log), retry timeout/network/5xx. Recover lost admission/final responses/requeue/crash between commit-enqueue without second admission/send; include final replay from queued/claimed. Preserve same event idempotency-key/Message-ID, refused SMTP recipients only, stale reminder drop and channel-specific key scope. Shutdown all loops before closing ledger; offline CLI regression/docs. Full checks, Security checklist, manual exercise and real-token A/B against merged API on BOTH sides with observed fresh/applied B.

Channel a resend leaves channel b failed; delivered -> not-failed, no payload -> no-payload, absent channel -> channel-unavailable; stale reminder ends dropped. Partial SMTP retries only refused recipients, 0 repeats to delivered recipients, same Message-ID. All loops stop before ledger close; offline CLI works on format 5 and exits 2 while locked.
